about: The Workbench icons of the DandyDungeon drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). art/dandydungeon.png is the game's own first player (tile 24 of dandy.bmp, Dandy Dungeon, Apache-2.0), 16 x 16 scaled to 64 x 64, black made clear. DandyDungeon-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, DandyDungeon.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for LICENSE.txt.
